lanes.title: Authorization action, OpenAPI, documentation, and evidence-manifest contracts
successCriteria: Every authenticated route is classified
Published JSON examples parse against shared schemas
Required evidence coverage has no missing or duplicate lane

lanes.title: Configuration preview, apply, reapply, failure, drift report, reconciliation, and manual preservation
prerequisites: No deployed identity provider or engine
successCriteria: Exact preview hash is required for apply
Same idempotency input replays the receipt
Invalid apply leaves persisted state unchanged
Drift is reported and a reviewed apply restores declared state
Manual records survive authoritative source-scoped cleanup

lanes.title: Configuration lock, drift detection, and reconciliation fail-closed behavior
successCriteria: Config-locked mutation is rejected
Config-warn mutation is marked drifted
Diff reports drift
Apply reconciles drift to in-sync

lanes.title: Standalone and provider-neutral identity authorization contracts
prerequisites: Protocol mocks use only generated test credentials
successCriteria: Standalone login policy remains covered
OIDC/Entra-compatible, SAML, and LDAP mappings normalize to one entitlement model
Multiple-provider source isolation and reconciliation are enforced

lanes.title: Distributed, shared, external-registry, and sidecar engine-mode contracts
prerequisites: Engine transports are mocked at the contract boundary
artifacts: Engine mode and tenant-resolution test result
successCriteria: Dedicated distributed engine resolution is tenant-safe
Shared centralized engines fail closed without mappings
External registry ownership cannot be mutated manually
Customer-sidecar transport uses the common authorization resolver

lanes.title: Secret and identity-token absence across configuration surfaces
successCriteria: Exports, API responses, logs, audit details, and CLI output contain no resolved secrets or bearer tokens

lanes.title: OpenShift ConfigMap, Secret, readiness, and rollout rendering contracts
successCriteria: Bundle ConfigMap and secret volumes are read-only and optional
Readiness is fail-closed
Rolling update retains a healthy ReplicaSet contractually

lanes.title: Disposable Docker startup without a configuration bundle
successCriteria: Fresh deployment starts ready without a bundle
No existing local stack or volume is modified

lanes.title: Disposable Docker bundle apply and restart idempotency
artifacts: Sanitized first-start and restart readiness receipts
successCriteria: Mounted bundle applies once
Restart against the same database reuses the applied state
No secret values are retained

lanes.title: Disposable Docker invalid bundle, hash mismatch, and unavailable-secret fail-closed behavior
successCriteria: Every invalid startup remains unready
Only stable sanitized diagnostics are emitted
Cleanup removes the disposable stack

lanes.title: Disposable OIDC, Entra-compatible OIDC, SAML, LDAP, and multiple-provider browser rehearsal
successCriteria: Each emulated provider signs in through its real protocol
Mapped access is added and removed through reconciliation
Provider source isolation remains intact

lanes.title: Real Operaton direct-engine native authorization container
successCriteria: Direct Operaton grants are read and enforced
Resource-type allow and sibling deny behavior is preserved

lanes.title: Real Operaton customer-sidecar mirrored-backstop container
prerequisites: Operaton and reference-sidecar image pull access
successCriteria: EnterpriseGlue reaches Operaton only through the customer sidecar
Peer transport and engine-local credentials remain outside EnterpriseGlue
Mirrored resource grants allow exact resources and deny siblings

lanes.title: Real OpenShift failed-rollout retention and recovery evidence
artifacts: Sanitized lane receipt for external evidence
SHA-256 references to retained cluster-side rollout evidence
successCriteria: Valid ConfigMap and Secret projection becomes ready
Invalid fail-closed bundle cannot replace the healthy ReplicaSet
Prior ready pods remain available
Known-good configuration recovers the rollout
No cluster credentials, routes, namespaces, tokens, or secrets enter retained evidence
